arm_mum.text: Come in, pet. Don't mind the cat. Yes, we're Armstrongs. No, we haven't stolen anything this week. Mostly.

The Armstrongs held the Debatable Land, Liddesdale and Eskdale, and were a terror to everyone. The famous one is Johnnie Armstrong of Gilnockie, hanged by James V in 1530 with 36 of his men. He is still the subject of a ballad.
A distant cousin of ours, Neil, walked on the Moon in 1969, and in 1972 was given the Freedom of Langholm, the old Armstrong country. The clan was very pleased. Nobody asked what he'd lifted.
